title: Annual Symposium: Reclaiming Historical Voices
author: Cornelia Team
excerpt: A recap of our flagship event where scholars from twelve countries gathered to discuss the methodology of reading against the grain in official archives to find the silenced narratives of women.
content:
Our annual symposium brings together scholars, activists, and community members.

The focus this year was on methodologies for uncovering women's histories.

Presentations highlighted marginalized voices in archival research.
